name: Boss dummy
source: character references/DUMMY: boss-dummy-stand.png (its colours the master's), boss-dummy-wobble-back.png and boss-dummy-wobble-forward.png (put back on the stand's colours with recolor-sprite.mjs, the stand's grid as their master: they had come back lighter and more orange), each sampled on a 3.6 px grid (the Guardian Golem's, whose design it is, drawn at his scale: its outlines come out two pixels thick as his do) and put on the stand's 32 colours; set on one canvas, the wobble back moved 27 pixels left and 1 down so that the foot it stands on stays where the stand's is, the wobble forward 3 down onto the same ground; with boss-dummy-falling-broken.png and boss-dummy-broken.png (put back on the stand's colours with recolor-sprite.mjs, sampled on the stand's grid, 3.6 px from 2.1, 2.9, set where the stand is, 19 right and 22 up, then each moved onto the floor line, the falling one 10 up, the broken one 27 down), the canvas 20 rows taller for the falling one's head; its foot set as it was (the stand's), not taken from the broken frames
